summary: NeOnc Technologies filed an 8-K regarding a private placement of up to $5 million of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $833.34 per share with accredited investors. The filing covers the securities purchase agreement, unregistered sale, and charter amendment designating the preferred stock. No merger, tender offer, spin-off, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is present. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
